definitions: A famous oil-on-canvas painting by the Dutch Post-Impressionist painter Vincent van Gogh.
One of the most recognizable and celebrated works in Western art history, depicting a dramatic night sky over a fictional village.
examples: The Starry Night is housed at the Museum of Modern Art in New York City.
Many art enthusiasts consider The Starry Night to be Van Gogh's masterpiece.
Reproductions of The Starry Night are popular.
